description: This file contains tests for gateway handshake timeout configurations and utility functions, primarily verifying defaults, environment variable overrides, and value clamping related to connection challenge timeouts.

methods.name: resolveConnectChallengeTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the connection challenge timeout, prioritizing override from environment variables if available, otherwise using the default or provided value.

methods.name: getConnectChallengeTimeoutMsFromEnv
methods.description: Reads the OPENCLAW_CONNECT_CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT_MS environment variable and converts it to a number if valid.

methods.name: getPreauthHandshakeTimeoutMsFromEnv
methods.description: Determines the pre-auth handshake timeout based on environment variables, preferring the test override if present.

methods.name: clampConnectChallengeTimeoutMs
methods.description: Clamps a given timeout value within the defined minimum and maximum bounds.
